description: Header file defining the Loader class and its implementation for managing build file execution and toolchain loading in a build system.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Abstract base class managing execution of build files and toolchain references.

classes.name: LoaderImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Loader, handling asynchronous file loading and build configuration management.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a build file within a specified toolchain context.

methods.name: ToolchainLoaded
methods.description: Notifies that a specific toolchain has finished loading.

methods.name: GetDefaultToolchain
methods.description: Returns the label of the default toolchain.

methods.name: GetToolchainSettings
methods.description: Retrieves settings for a specified toolchain label.

methods.name: BuildFileForLabel
methods.description: Returns the build file associated with a given label.

methods.name: set_task_runner
methods.description: Sets the task runner for the main thread.

methods.name: set_complete_callback
methods.description: Sets callback to be invoked when all pending loads are complete.

methods.name: set_async_load_file
methods.description: Sets the callback for asynchronous file loading.

methods.name: set_build_file_extension
methods.description: Defines additional extension for build files.

methods.name: default_toolchain_label
methods.description: Returns the label of the default toolchain.

methods.name: ScheduleLoadFile
methods.description: Schedules a file to be loaded.

methods.name: ScheduleLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Schedules a build configuration to be loaded.

methods.name: BackgroundLoadFile
methods.description: Loads a file on a background thread.

methods.name: BackgroundLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Loads a build config on a background thread.

methods.name: DidLoadFile
methods.description: Handles completion of a file load.

methods.name: DidLoadBuildConfig
methods.description: Handles completion of a build config load.

methods.name: DecrementPendingLoads
methods.description: Decrements load counter and triggers completion callback if zero.
